provides: The design uses reversible +/-2mA,10mV-compliance Kelvin observations with a custom four-tip stepped probe, introduced .05N/tip force and displacement monitoring, followed by functional proof with tools removed. A probe can improve a weak contact temporarily. Opening both terminals of one retained capacitor defeats masking by seven parallel capacitors; a rail-level capacitance pass does not authenticate every part. Closed microcracks and latent damage remain outside short electrical observations, and the10Gohm assembled requirement is not proved by a low-voltage short scan.
